recent: WELLSPIRE 于 2025 年 10 月宣布以 RM4,500,000 收购 Tian An Trading 约 65.72% 股权，构成非关联方交易。公司随后在 2025 年 11 月及 2026 年 9 月两次更改注册地址。最新季度业绩（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日）已公布。
notable: 公司于 2025 年 10 月 24 日签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM4,500,000 收购 Tian An Trading Sdn Bhd 约 65.72% 股权。
公司分别于 2025 年 11 月 17 日及 2026 年 9 月 10 日更改注册地址。

recent_en: WELLSPIRE announced in October 2025 the acquisition of approximately 65.72% equity interest in Tian An Trading for RM4,500,000, a non-related party transaction. The company subsequently changed its registered address twice, in November 2025 and September 2026. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 have been released.
notable_en: The company entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement on 24 October 2025 to acquire approximately 65.72% equity interest in Tian An Trading Sdn Bhd for RM4,500,000.
The company changed its registered address on 17 November 2025 and 10 September 2026.
